name: Golf Caddie
tagline: A caddie for weekend rounds, from packing the bag to the club call
description: Built for players who get out on a Saturday rather than every day of the week. Before you leave it checks conditions at the course and helps you settle what goes in the bag; standing over an awkward lie you can send a photo and get a club back; afterwards it keeps your notes beside the card. Short, plain advice.
author: Brantley
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
